steps.rights_subtitle: All media uploaded to Wikimedia Commons are free for anyone to use and share anywhere on internet or off internet. To ensure the work you upload is copyright-free, please provide the following information.

rights.ownership_own: This work was created by me and anyone is free to use it.
rights.ownership_thirdparty: This work was created by someone else and it is free to share.
rights.tp_intro: You can upload someone else's work as long as it is published under a free license or its copyright has expired.
rights.own_origin_label: Is this entirely your own work?
rights.own_origin_own: This work is entirely created by me
rights.own_origin_others: This work contains the work of others
rights.own_origin_ai: I generated this work using an artificial intelligence tool
rights.own_others_label: Is other people's work in this media free to use and share?
rights.own_others_freelicense: Yes, the creator has published the work under a free license e.g. Creative Commons licenses
rights.own_others_nocopyright: Yes, the work is not protected by any copyright law
rights.own_others_copyrighted: No, the work is copyright protected
rights.own_others_copyrighted_warning: Do not upload this file! Wikimedia Commons does not host media protected by copyright. Only media with free licenses or in the public domain are permitted on Wikimedia Commons.
rights.own_others_unknown: I don't know if it is free to use and share
rights.own_others_unknown_warning: Do not upload this file! Only media with free licenses or in the public domain are permitted on Wikimedia Commons. If you are in any doubt, please learn more about what is permitted, or ask experienced contributors before uploading. Thank you.
rights.ai_engine_label: Enter the name of the artificial intelligence engine used. If someone else's original work was used to generate this work, list them as well.
rights.ai_engine_hint: Example: Midjourney AI; Photograph by Ansel Adams; colorized with Colorme AI, etc.
rights.ai_prompt_label: Enter the prompt that was used in generating this media
rights.tp_reason_label: Please choose why this work is free to share. Providing incorrect information may result in the deletion of your media.
rights.tp_reason_freelicense: The creator has released or published this work under a free license e.g. Creative Commons license
rights.tp_reason_heir: I am the heir to the intellectual property of the person who created this
rights.tp_reason_nocopyright: This work is not protected by copyright law
rights.tp_reason_nocopyright_hint: Example: old work whose copyright has expired or work released by government as public records, etc.
rights.tp_reason_permission: I have permission to upload this work from my employer or the creator of this work
rights.tp_permission_warning: The creator of this work or their representative must send a written consent to permissions-commons@wikimedia.org in order to release this work under a free license. If the email is not sent within 30 days of upload, this media will be deleted.
rights.tp_reason_unknown: I don't know if it is free to share
rights.tp_reason_unknown_warning: Do not upload this file! Only media with free licenses or in the public domain are permitted on Wikimedia Commons. If you are in any doubt, please learn more about what is permitted, or ask experienced contributors before uploading. Thank you.
rights.source_label: Where did you find this work? Enter the website, the book, or another source.
rights.is_ai_label: This work is generated in an artificial intelligence tool
rights.author_label: Enter the name of the original author of this work.
rights.author_unknown_label: I do not know who the author is
rights.ai_info_label: Enter the name of the artificial intelligence engine used, followed by the name of the person who created the prompt:
rights.ai_info_hint: Example: Midjourney AI; prompted by Jane Doe
rights.ai_info_unknown_label: I do not have this information

licenses.own_license_label: What license do you want to publish this work under? All media on Commons should be published under a free license.
licenses.tp_creator_license_label: Do you know what license the creator published this work under?
licenses.tp_heir_license_label: What license do you want to release this work under?
licenses.tp_permission_license_label: Select the type of license this work is intended to be released under
licenses.cc0_hint: release all rights, anyone is free to use this work in any way
licenses.cc_by_hint: requires the person using this media to give appropriate credit
licenses.cc_by_sa_hint: requires the person using this media to give appropriate credit and distribute under the same license
licenses.custom_hint: Must contain a valid copyright tag in a valid template such as '{{Cc-by-2.0}}'
licenses.license_unknown_warning: Do not upload this file unless you are certain of the license under which it was published. If you are in any doubt, please learn more about what is permitted, or ask experienced contributors before uploading. Thank you.
licenses.tp_pd_label: Which of the options below is true? Check all that apply.
licenses.tp_pd_hint: Wikimedia Commons is located in the USA, so the work must be out of copyright in USA as well.
licenses.pd_us_expired: First published in the United States before 1931
licenses.pd_old_70: Author has been deceased for more than 70 years
licenses.pd_usgov: Original work of the US Federal Government
licenses.pd_unsure: I am not sure if it is out of copyright in USA
licenses.pd_tag_label: Add a specific public domain tag, if applicable.
licenses.pd_tag_hint: Must contain a valid public domain tag in a valid template such as '{{Pd-old-70}}'

RemoveBackground.title: Remove background
RemoveBackground.threshold_help: Higher values remove more of the background. Lower values keep soft edges such as hair.
RemoveBackground.apply_warning: Applying replaces the background with the cut-out version. Your annotations stay in place and remain editable. The editor's Undo button reverts it.
RemoveBackground.restore_warning: Restore brings back the background as it was before it was removed. Your annotations are kept. The editor's Undo button reverts the restore.
RemoveBackground.png_hint: Transparent areas are only kept when the file is uploaded as PNG.
RemoveBackground.unavailable: Background removal is not available on this server.
